nodes.title: Stage 1 — Seedance 2.5 Draft (T2V)
widgets_values: 16:9, cinematic, single continuous take. Refs: @Image1 character, @Image2 location, @Clay Render 1 blocking. 0–10s: the character crosses into the location and lands the clay-blockout mark. 10–20s: one continuous move, camera stays with them, wardrobe unchanged. 20–30s: they settle on the end mark in the same light. No subtitles, No BGM. Keep identity/wardrobe locked.

nodes.title: Stage 2 — ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Draft to Final Video
Pack C — read before queue
widgets_values:
Agent-Slate Pack C reference graph for Comfy Desk. Both stages ship bypassed (node mode 4) so opening this graph does not submit a Partner task.

Stage 1 scout — enable these nodes together (mode 0), queue once: model option Seedance 2.5 Draft, model id dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628, draft true, resolution 480p. Keep control_after_generate on fixed and keep the same seed integer. Save Text writes draft_task_id to a txt in the output folder. Use the same prompt and the same refs on the promote.

Stage 2 promote — within 7 days, paste that draft_task_id into ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Draft to Final Video, set Stage 1 back to bypass, set Stage 2 to mode 0, queue once. The final is native 1080p. Prompt, refs, duration, aspect ratio, seed, and generate_audio are inherited. There is no prompt field on the final node.

generate_audio is false because post owns the soundtrack. Turn it on only when this take must carry its own dialogue or sound effects.

A second Stage 1 queue creates a new draft. Leave Stage 1 bypassed once the preview is approved.
